title: Gregoris (2026): scoped audit of Tolman VI neutrino phase equations
citation: Daniele Gregoris, The European Physical Journal C 86, 1238, published 2026-10-27; https://link.springer.com/article/10.1140/epjc/s10052-026-16462-w
materials: Publisher HTML text, original HTML TeX for eight equations, publication metadata, units/coordinate notes, and data/code statements; original PDF pages 4-5 visually inspected for equations 7, 8, 12, 13 and adjacent definitions. Full PDF derivations, cited background papers, author correspondence, observational data, and a formal proof system were not inspected.
decision_context: Assess whether selected equations are internally consistent and what additional evidence is needed before relying on the proposed physical interpretation. Not a judgment of the entire paper.

claims.text: Our research puts forward, in the context of the Tolman VI metric, an observational method for identifying naked singularities in our Universe: neutrinos would simultaneously be physically overlapped, in flavor-equilibrium and quantum-mechanically scrambled.
claims.label: PROPOSED
claims.measurand: Proposed joint neutrino signature, not an observed event in this work
claims.range: Static spherical Tolman VI model and stated propagation/coherence approximations; no measured astrophysical realization inspected
claims.instrument: Theoretical analytic model; no physical detector experiment conducted in this review
claims.falsifiers: A compatible measured dataset or a fully established internal derivation conflict could bear on a scoped version of the proposal; the selected local sign discrepancy alone does not falsify this entire abstract claim.

tools.output: Routed as THEORETICAL from publisher classification and no-associated-data/code statements. Selected equation checks are local numerical/analytic authoring work, not a new physical experiment.
Preserved the abstract proposal separately from eight source equation records. Overall claim support remains UNDETERMINED; narrow criterion results are in artifacts/evidence-bundle.json.

Recorded static spherical metric, positive-radius domain, a=7/4 coefficient specialization, common E and L, phase/mass ordering, and small m^2/q for local probes. Full coordinate normalization, WKB control near r=0, and astrophysical boundary matching were not established.

The publisher article and its HTML TeX are one source lineage, not independent confirmations. Local calculations are separately authored checks but not independent empirical reproduction; references and preprint lineage were not fully audited.

Selected original PDF signs match the HTML. Source typo, phase-order/convention mismatch, authoring implementation error, and a substantive derivation issue remain candidates. No root cause selected; literal Eq8 and Eq12 comparison disagrees in sign at three admissible inputs.

Kept exact coefficient identities, numerical sample results, source claims, unknowns, and interpretations distinct. Preserved first malformed trial-reference attempt and corrected bundle. Full scientific validity is not established.

decisions.text: Does the candidate sign discrepancy reflect a publication typo, a convention mismatch, an error in this review, or a substantive derivation issue?
Can the proposed naked-singularity signature be relied on without a wider derivation, approximation-domain, and observation-model review?

notes: Criterion mappings are draft proposals, not a running general inference engine. Prototype 0.1 compatibility UNKNOWN; voice DEFERRED. No full-paper validity verdict, score, or automatically established scientific support.
